SemVer Calculator

Enter a version and bump type to get the exact next semver, including prerelease handling.

—
Next version

📖 How to use

  1. Type the current version (e.g. 1.4.2).
  2. Pick a bump type and optional prerelease tag.
  3. Click Calculate — the next version appears.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Which bump types are supported?

major, minor, patch, premajor, preminor, prepatch, and prerelease — all per the semver spec.

What happens to build metadata?

Build metadata (+build) is dropped on any bump, as the spec recommends.

How do prerelease bumps work?

prerelease on 1.2.3-beta.1 gives 1.2.3-beta.2; on 1.2.3 it gives 1.2.3-<tag>.1.

Is the input validated?

Yes — versions are parsed strictly (optional leading v) and invalid input is rejected.
